long_biography.plain_text:
Acquiring Plaspen in 2001 turned Mustafa Sak's Adopen brand into a larger industrial company with production in Istanbul and an expanding national sales network. He had introduced Adopen four years earlier inside Çağlar Plastik, the family business where he learned manufacturing and administration after studying international business in the United States.

Sak moved the enterprise's industrial centre back to Antalya and developed ADO Group across PVC systems, composite doors, flooring and related building materials. His engagement with Akdeniz University created another durable institution. He helped fund engineering faculty buildings and established annual achievement awards for high-performing graduates. The programme has continued for more than a decade.
